Extracted the complete site mega-menu from props.pageProps.headerData.menuItems embedded in a category page's __NEXT_DATA__ (saved w123_next_data.json / w123_menu_dump2.txt) and walked BOTH full Home sub-trees: 'Acquista per stanza' (Giardino ed esterni, Soggiorno, Cucina, Camera da letto, Bagno, Arredamento Cameretta, Camerette, Ingresso) and 'Acquista per prodotto' (Decorazioni, Tende/textiles, Biancheria letto, Cucina e camera da pranzo, Bagno & Doccia, Selezione Premium, Abbigliamento da notte, Mobili, Bambini e neonati, Profumi per la casa, Contenitori, Illuminazione, Piante, Ultime opportunita, Gift Card, Tutti i marchi) down to every leaf node (1196-line full dump) - zero nodes named or pathed with any pet/animal term (checked animali, pet, cane, gatto, cuccia, guinzagli, lettiera, ciotole, trasportino, collare). Cross-checked against the site's XML sitemap index: fetched ALL 30 'subdepartment' shards site-wide (2864 URLs total, covering every department incl. Home) and ran the same keyword sweep - only 2 hits, both false positives unrelated to Home/pets ('donna/acquista-per-prodotto/petite.html' = women's petite clothing size, 'donna/ispirazione/animal-print.html' = an animal-print fashion pattern under Women's clothing inspiration). The mega-menu walk is the authoritative nav source that drives the site's own category pages; the full sitemap sweep is corroborating, independent confirmation of the same null result. Prior Home-Decor pass for this same SR (archive c134, see notes/123.md) independently never surfaced any pet-related node either, across the same two sub-trees. Conclusion: genuine absence, not a coverage gap - H&M Home Italy sells decor/furniture/textiles/kitchen/bath/lighting/kids but no pet products on this market site.
